_evidence.note: Records what one machine measured. Any other host is unqualified until it runs the qualification itself; see docs/evidence/README.md.
_evidence.scope: MACHINE-SPECIFIC EVIDENCE, NOT A PORTABLE CLAIM

knownLimitations: UCX direct receive into ROCm device memory is DISABLED on the WSL DXG path: uct_rocm_copy stores from the CPU into memory that is not host-accessible and faults. Host staging is the only qualified receive path for ROCm here.
Vendor-local NCCL/RCCL groups of a single rank are degenerate; collective results validate orchestration and cross-vendor routing only, not multi-rank vendor-local behaviour.
A ROCm PyTorch wheel on WSL may need a provisional HSA runtime patch (see runtime/bridge/rocm_torch_patch.sh). That configuration is unsupported by AMD and PyTorch.
No unified VRAM. The two cards remain separate memory domains.

reasons: cuda device memory faulted on host store and load
transport receive into cuda memory was verified byte-for-byte
rocm device memory faulted on host store and load
transport receive into rocm memory failed correctness testing
staging through pinned host memory is the only qualified path

notes: device memory is never exposed to the wire; only vendor adapters touch it
UCX receive into ROCm memory stays disabled on the DXG path
collectives are layered above this transport, not provided by it
